author: IGN
description:
Check out the Songs of the Past Gameplay Showcase for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, an upcoming DLC and remastered version of the legendary action RPG developed by CD Projekt Red. Players can get an in-depth look at both The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered and the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion, bringing current-gen updates and a new adventure into the new realm of Letten, respectively. Don't miss over 12 minutes of gameplay for both The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered, launching on September 29, and the upcoming Songs of the Past Expansion launching in 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GoG, Epic Games Store, and Battle.Net).

#TheWitcher3WildHuntRemastered #Gaming #IGN
title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered - Official Songs of the Past Gameplay Showcase | gamescom 2026

author: IGN
description:
The Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is set to wrap up with 2027s Final Fantasy VII Revelation, and we are excited to finally battle the Weapons. We caught up with Naoki Hamaguchi, Game Director on FF7 Revelation, who gave us insights into how the Weapons are integrated into the story, Chadley's new role in the story, and what exactly he might be doing with all that combat training data...
Final Fantasy VII Revelation is coming in early 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: How Weapons & Chadley Are Integrated Into the Story | gamescom

author: IGN
description:
Put your creativity to the test in Dreampainters! Get a fresh look at gameplay and more from Dreampainters in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person puzzle game. Discover the surreal world of an artist's dreams and use a paintbrush to unfold its mysteries with striking colors. Or grab a friend to paint your dreams together in two-player co-op dedicated missions. Dreampainters will be available on PC in 2027. A playtest is out now on Steam, and you can wishlist Dreampainters on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479080/Dreampainters/

author: IGN
description:
What's the best game at Gamescom 2026? There's some huge competition, including the return of The Witcher 3 (possibly the greatest game of all time), but for Jim's money? Silent Hill Townfall's take on a terrifying Scottish fishing village is the one to beat.

Gamescom is the biggest gaming convention on Earth, in every sense. Physically, it's the size of a small town, with roughly the population of Swansea visiting every day from all over the globe. It's a dizzying celebration of gaming's past, present, and future. Join me on my first Gamescom with IGN for a window into what this behemoth is like to work in, and along the way we'll see some cool stuff, have a few laughs, and even preview some upcoming games: everything from Silent Hill Townfall to The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past!

#gamescom #ign
title: I Think I Love Silent Hill: Townfall, But I Also Saw So Much More! | gamescom 2026
